name: Spined Devil

actions.name: Tail Spine
actions.effect: Ranged attack at medium range. The spine embeds in the target, dealing 1d6 fire at the start of each turn until removed (1 action).

actions.name: Spine Volley
actions.effect: Launches spines at up to 3 targets within medium range.

reactions.name: Evasive Flight
reactions.effect: When targeted by a melee attack, the Spined Devil flies up to 6m away without provoking reactions.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: Can fly. Does not provoke reactions when flying out of reach.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Can see perfectly in magical and non-magical darkness up to 36m.

lore: Spined Devils are winged, spine-covered fiends that serve as scouts and harassers in infernal armies. They circle above battlefields, peppering enemies with burning tail spines while staying out of melee range.
